var result = [];
for (var i = 0; i < bes.length; i++) {

    var bsej = java.base64Decode(bes[i]);
    var txtt = String(bsej);
    result.push(txtt);
      }
	var txt = result.join('\n');
}
txt;

//md5加密开始
var rotateLeft = function(lValue, iShiftBits) {
    return (lValue << iShiftBits) | (lValue >>> (32 - iShiftBits))
}
var addUnsigned = function(lX, lY) {
    var lX4, lY4, lX8, lY8, lResult;
    lX8 = (lX & 0x80000000);
    lY8 = (lY & 0x80000000);
    lX4 = (lX & 0x40000000);
    lY4 = (lY & 0x40000000);
    lResult = (lX & 0x3FFFFFFF) + (lY & 0x3FFFFFFF);
    if (lX4 & lY4) return (lResult ^ 0x80000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
    if (lX4 | lY4) {
        if (lResult & 0x40000000) return (lResult ^ 0xC0000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
        else return (lResult ^ 0x40000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    } else {
        return (lResult ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    }
}
var F = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x & y) | ((~x) & z)
}
var G = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x & z) | (y & (~z))
}
var H = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x ^ y ^ z)
}
var I = function(x, y, z) {
    return (y ^ (x | (~z)))
}
var FF = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(F(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var GG = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(G(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)

var rotateLeft = function(lValue, iShiftBits) {
    return (lValue << iShiftBits) | (lValue >>> (32 - iShiftBits))
}
var addUnsigned = function(lX, lY) {
    var lX4, lY4, lX8, lY8, lResult;
    lX8 = (lX & 0x80000000);
    lY8 = (lY & 0x80000000);
    lX4 = (lX & 0x40000000);
    lY4 = (lY & 0x40000000);
    lResult = (lX & 0x3FFFFFFF) + (lY & 0x3FFFFFFF);
    if (lX4 & lY4) return (lResult ^ 0x80000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
    if (lX4 | lY4) {
        if (lResult & 0x40000000) return (lResult ^ 0xC0000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
        else return (lResult ^ 0x40000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    } else {
        return (lResult ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    }
}

var G = function(x, y, z) {

<js>
(() => {
	try {
		data = JSON.parse(source.getVariable())
	} catch (err) {
		data = {}
	}
	sessionID = data.sessionID||"";
	if (!sessionID) {
		chars = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456789";
		charsLength = chars.length
		for (i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
			sessionID += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * charsLength))
		}
		data.sessionID = sessionID
		source.setVariable(JSON.stringify(data))
	}
	return JSON.stringify({
		"cookie": "PHPSESSID=" + sessionID,
		"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 13_3_1 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/13.0.5 Mobile/15E148 Snapchat/10.77.5.59 (like Safari/604.1)"
	})
})()

【话本小说 · 使用说明】(本书源基于 Legado MD3 版本制作调试)
■ 这是什么
话本小说网(www.ihuaben.com)书源, 以同人/原创小说为主, 免费在线阅读。
■ 搜索说明
1. 支持书名/作者搜索(话本站内搜索 so.ihuaben.com)
2. 注意: 话本是同人/原创平台, 没有主流网文(如斗破苍穹等搜不到属正常)
3. 若开「精确搜索」, 只返回书名与关键词完全一致的结果
■ 发现页(5个榜单)
点击榜 / 评论榜 / 收藏榜 / 新书榜 / 新手村, 各100条
■ 正文阅读
1. 章节开头的角色对话已排版为「头像+名字：台词」(模拟聊天, 线性排列)
2. 已自动清除: 评论数字徽标、段评、作者语(角色对话保留)
3. 正文插图已保留; 文字嵌入模式下头像按文字行高显示(较小)
■ MD3版本注意事项
1. 若换书后图片样式未生效: 从书架删除该书重新加入
2. 首次打开较长的书, 目录页(全量章节)加载略慢属正常
3. 图片排版受Legado MD3文本阅读器限制: 图片只能「小尺寸内联同行」或「大尺寸独占一行」, 无法像原网站聊天气泡那样左右分栏

<js>
var doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(result));
var cs = doc.select('#contentsource').first();
if (cs) {
  cs.select('i.num, .passage-cosplay-preview, script, style').remove();
  var talks = cs.select('.talk');
  for (var i = 0; i < talks.size(); i++) {
    var t = talks.get(i);
    var avatarSrc = '';
    var av = t.select('.avatar img').first();
    if (av) avatarSrc = av.attr('src');
    var nm = t.select('.name').first();
    var name = nm ? nm.text() : '';
    var msg = t.select('.talkcontent p').text();
    var p = doc.createElement('p');
    if (avatarSrc) {
      var img = doc.createElement('img');
      img.attr('src', avatarSrc);
      p.appendChild(img);
    }
    p.appendText(name + '：' + msg);
    t.replaceWith(p);
  }
  result = cs.html();
}
result;
</js>

<js>
var JsDom = Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup;
var Document = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Document;
var Element = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Element;
            
var document = JsDom.parse(src);
            
// 获取包含<li>元素的<div>元素
var divs = document.select('ul.list > div');

// 将divs转换为数组以便排序
var divArray = [];
for (var i = 0; i < divs.size(); i++) {
    divArray.push(divs.get(i));
}

// 按照data-id属性对divArray进行排序
divArray.sort(function(a, b) {
    var pageA = parseInt(a.attr('data-id'), 10);
    var pageB = parseInt(b.attr('data-id'), 10);
    return pageA - pageB;
});

var list = [];
// 遍历排序后的divArray
for (var i = 0; i < divArray.length; i++) {
    var div = divArray[i];
    var dataId = div.attr('data-id');
    // 获取当前div下的所有<li>元素
    var lis = div.select('li');
    for (var j = 0; j < lis.size(); j++) {
        var li = lis.get(j);
        var a = li.select('a').first();
        if (a != null) {
            list.push({
                text: a.text(),
                id: dataId, // 使用data-id属性
                url: a.attr('href')
            });
        }
    }
}

//java.log(JSON.stringify(list));
list;
</js>

var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
    Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.android.util
);

with(javaImport){
    function decrypt(str){
        var key=SecretKeySpec(String("1701019k").getBytes(),"DES");
        var iv=IvParameterSpec(java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AQIDBAUGBwg="));
        var bytes=Base64.decode(String(str).getBytes(),2);
        var chipher=Cipher.getInstance("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
        chipher.init(2,key,iv);
        return String(chipher.doFinal(bytes));
    }
}

</js>

<js>
if(!/apk\/detail/.test(baseUrl)){
    let id = "{{$.data.id}}";
    let html = ""
    let item = JSON.parse(result).data;
    let curPage = 1;
    let lastItem = "";
    let resp2 = JSON.parse(java.ajax("https://api.coolapk.com/v6/feed/replyList?id={{$.data.id}}&page=1&lastItem="));
    let replynum5 = item.replynum;
    replynum5 > 100?replynum5=100:replynum5
    html += createReply(item)
    let item_reply = []
    let totalnum = 0
    let item2 = resp2.data
    item_reply = item_reply.concat(item2)
    while (item2.length && (totalnum = totalnum + item2.length) < replynum5) {
      curPage = curPage + 1
      lastItem = item2[item2.length - 1].id
      resp2 = JSON.parse(java.ajax(`https://api.coolapk.com/v6/feed/replyList?id=${id}&page=${curPage}&lastItem=${lastItem}`))
      item2 = resp2.data
      item_reply = item_reply.concat(item2)
    }

    let grouped_item_reply = {}
    item_reply.map(item => {
      if (item.rrid) {
        grouped_item_reply[item.rrid] = grouped_item_reply[item.rrid] || []
        grouped_item_reply[item.rrid].push(item)
      } else {
        grouped_item_reply[item.id] = grouped_item_reply[item.id] || []
        grouped_item_reply[item.id].push(item)
      }
    })
    for (key in grouped_item_reply) {
      grouped_item_reply[key].sort((e1, e2) => {
        return e1.dateline - e2.dateline
      }).map(item => html += createReply(item, !!item.rrid))
    }
    result = String(html).replace(/<a .*?href="([^"]+)".*?>([^<]+)<\/a>/g,'▪$2：$1▪')
   }else{
   	let html = "软件地址：\nhttps://www.coolapk.com/apk/{{$.data.apkname}}\n";
   	 html +="---复制下面文字到发现规则可看评论---\n"
   	html += "{{$.data.title}}▪回复::https://api.coolapk.com/v6/page/dataList?url=#/feed/apkCommentList?id={{$.data.id}}&sort=&title=最近回复&page={\{page}}&lastItem=\n"

html += "{{$.data.title}}▪发布::https://api.coolapk.com/v6/page/dataList?url=#/feed/apkCommentList?id=256030&sort=dateline_desc&title=最近发布&page={\{page}}&lastItem=\n"

html += "{{$.data.title}}▪热度::https://api.coolapk.com/v6/page/dataList?url=#/feed/apkCommentList?id={{$.data.id}}&sort=popular&title=热度排序&page={\{page}}&lastItem=\n"
   	}
</js>

 - 如果该书源网站你在手机浏览器上也是无限循环人机验证，那么说明是你系统的 WebView 版本太低了，建议升级到最少 11x 版本。
 - 如果该书源网站你在手机浏览器能通过人机验证，那么说明是你手机系统 WebView 内核版本与当前书源所用的 UA 中的 WebView 版本信息相差过大，请将书源【搜索 - 搜索地址】规则中 `Chrome/115.0.4664.104` 的 115 这个大版本号修改为你手机系统的 WebView 内核版本（比如你是 96.0.x.x 那就将 115 改成 96，后面的小版本号不影响）。

time = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000).toString()

function getSign (key, type, num) {
  const { java } = this
  const secret = 'magic2019'
  let baseString

  switch (type) {
    case 's':
      baseString = `channel=ft0001&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=0&query=${java.encodeURI(key)}&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 't':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&gid=1&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 'c':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&chapterid=${num}&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    default:
      throw new Error('Invalid type')
  }

  return java.md5Encode(baseString).toUpperCase()
}

exploreUrl:
<js>
function styles(so) {
    var today = new Date();
    var dateT = today.getFullYear()
        + '-'
        + (today.getMonth() + 1)
        + '-'
        + today.getDate()
        + '_discover_tabs';

    var url = Api('/api/discover/tabs');
    var res = null;
    var cacheData = '';
    var sourceItem = null;
    var result = [];
    var tab;
    var count = 0;
    var i;
    var u;

    try {
        cacheData = cache.get(dateT)+"1";

        if (cacheData) {
            try {
                res = JSON.parse(cacheData);
            } catch (e) {
                res = null;
            }
        }

        if (!res) {
            res = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url));

            if (res && res.code == 0) {
                cache.put(dateT, JSON.stringify(res));
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        return [{
            title: '数据加载失败，请刷新后重试',
            url: '',
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];
    }

    if (!res || res.code != 0 || !res.data || !res.data.sources) {
        return [{
            title: '请先登陆，登陆后刷新发现页即可',
            url: '',
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];
    }

    for (i = 0; i < res.data.sources.length; i++) {
        if (res.data.sources[i] && res.data.sources[i].name == so) {
            sourceItem = res.data.sources[i];
            break;
        }
    }

    if (!sourceItem || !sourceItem.tabs || sourceItem.tabs.length == 0) {
        return [{
            title: '暂无' + (so || '') + '发现内容',
            url: '',
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];
    }

    for (i = 0; i < sourceItem.tabs.length; i++) {
        tab = sourceItem.tabs[i];

        if (!tab) {
            continue;
        }

        if (tab.section) {
            if (count > 0) {
                while (count < 3) {
                    result.push({
                        title: '--',
                        url: '',
                        style: {
                            layout_flexGrow: 1,
                            layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
                        }
                    });
                    count++;
                }
            }

            result.push({
                title: tab.title || '',
                url: '',
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
                }
            });

            count = 0;
            continue;
        }

        u = '/api/discover/content?source='
            + encodeURIComponent(sourceItem.source || '')
            + '&tab='
            + encodeURIComponent(tab.key || '')
            + '&page={{page}}&page_size=12';

        result.push({
            title: tab.title || '',
            url: Api(u),
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
            }
        });

        count++;

        if (count >= 3) {
            count = 0;
        }
    }

    if (count > 0) {
        while (count < 3) {
            result.push({
                title: '--',
                url: '',
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
                }
            });

            count++;
        }
    }

    return result;
}

var so = cache.get('sources') || '起点小说';

var s = [
    create(
        "请选择平台",
        ["起点小说", "番茄小说", "七猫小说", "书旗小说", "塔读小说","红烛故事","西瓜小说","轻小说"],
        so,
        "sources",
        1
    )
];



JSON.stringify(s.concat(styles(so)), null, 2);
</js>

<js>
(function(){
    // 使用正则检测分页标签
    const hasNextLink = /<a\s+rel=\"next\"\s+class=\"next\"[^>]*>下—页<\/a>/i.test(result);
    if (!hasNextLink) return '';
    
    try {
        // 动态生成分页URL（适配数字型URL）
        let url = baseUrl;
        const pageMatch = url.match(/(\d+)(?:_(\d+))?\.html$/);
        if (!pageMatch) return '';
        
        const [_, baseId, currentPage] = pageMatch;
        const pageNum = currentPage ? parseInt(currentPage) : 1;
        
        // 安全限制（最大3页）
        if (pageNum > 2) return ''; // 第3页后停止
        
        // 生成新URL（如 /123_2.html → /123_3.html）
        return url.replace(/(\d+)(?:_(\d+))?\.html$/, `${baseId}_${pageNum + 1}.html`);
    } catch(e) {
        return '';
    }
})()
</js>

time = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000).toString()

function getSign (key, type, num) {
  const { java } = this
  const secret = 'magic2019'
  let baseString

  switch (type) {
    case 's':
      baseString = `channel=ft0001&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=0&query=${java.encodeURI(key)}&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 't':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&gid=1&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 'c':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&chapterid=${num}&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    default:
      throw new Error('Invalid type')
  }

  return java.md5Encode(baseString).toUpperCase()
}

<js>
function setArgument(key, value) {
    var open_argument = source.getVariable();
    open_argument = getArguments(open_argument, '') || {};
    open_argument[key] = value;
    var result = JSON.stringify(open_argument);
    source.setVariable(result);
    return result;
}

var open_argument = source.getVariable();
var base_url = getArguments(open_argument, 'server') || '';
var ms = getArguments(open_argument, 'tone_id') || '';
var source_type = getArguments(open_argument, 'source_type') || '男频';
var tab = getArguments(open_argument, 'media') || '小说';
var sources = getArguments(open_argument, 'source') || '番茄';


var sdtoken;
try {
    var loginInfoMap = source.getLoginInfoMap ? source.getLoginInfoMap() : {};
    sdtoken = String(loginInfoMap['手动填写番茄token(可不填)'] || '');
} catch (e) {
    sdtoken = '';
}

var rawCookie = getFanqieCookie() || sdtoken;
var match = rawCookie.match(/sessionid=[^;]+/);
var fqcookie = match ? match[0] : '';
var fqssionid = '';
if (!fqcookie) {
    java.toast('您还未登陆番茄账号，无法同步数据哦！');
} else {
    fqssionid = getSessionId(fqcookie)
}
var fqsjurl = base_url + "/bookshelf?page={{page}}&ssionid=" + fqssionid;
var fqtjurl = base_url + "/fqrecommend?page={{page}}&ssionid=" + fqssionid;
var fqlsurl = base_url + "/fqhistory?page={{page}}&ssionid=" + fqssionid;

var groupDatas = [];
var infoData = [];

function deviceType() {
    try {
        return !!java.androidId();
    } catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
}

var hasValidCookie = fqcookie.length > 0;

if (hasValidCookie) {
    function groupQuery() {
        try {
            var url = base_url + "/group_name?ssionid=" + fqssionid;
            var res = java.ajax(url);
            var response = JSON.parse(res);

            if (!(response && response.data)) {}

            response.data.forEach(function(group) {
                var keys = Object.keys(group);
                if (keys.length > 0) {
                    var key = keys[0];
                    var value = group[key];
                    if (value && value.length) {
                        var option = {
                            "method": "POST",
                            "body": {
                                "book_ids": value,
                                "page": "{{page}}"
                            }
                        };
                        groupDatas.push({
                            title: key,
                            url: base_url + "/bookshelf," + JSON.stringify(option),
                            style: {
                                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                                layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }
            });

            if (groupDatas.length % 2 !== 0) {
                groupDatas.push({
                    title: "--",
                    url: "",
                    style: {
                        layout_flexGrow: 1,
                        layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
                    }
                });
            }
        } catch (e) {
            java.longToast("番茄登录过期，已隐藏番茄书架");
        }
    }

    try {
        java.longToast("正在加载分组数据...");
        var userUrl = base_url + "/fquser?ssionid=" + fqssionid;
        var userRes = java.ajax(userUrl);
        var userData = JSON.parse(userRes);

        var userName = (userData && userData.data && userData.data.name) ? userData.data.name : '未知用户';
        if (!userName.includes('未知用户')) {
            infoData = [{
                title: userName + "个人中心",
                url: fqsjurl,
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
                }
            }, {
                title: "个性推荐(番茄)",
                url: fqtjurl,
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
                }
            }, {
                title: "历史阅读(番茄)",
                url: fqlsurl,
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
                }
            }];
        }
        groupQuery();
    } catch (e) {
        java.longToast("番茄登录过期，已隐藏番茄书架");
    }
}

var style_list = [];
try {
    var durl = `${base_url}/discovestyle?source=${sources}&source_type=${source_type}&tab=${tab}`;
    var res = java.ajax(durl);
    var result = JSON.parse(res);
    style_list = result.data || [];
    if (result.msg) {
        java.toast(result.msg);
    }
} catch (e) {
    java.toast("发现样式获取失败");
}

var finalData = infoData.concat(groupDatas, style_list);
JSON.stringify(finalData);
</js>

    word_number,

    score,
    abstract,
    copyright_info
} = result;

    proxy = "本地网络";
} else {
    proxy = "服务器网络";
}
java.put("book_detail", JSON.stringify(result));

let base_url = getArguments(source.getVariable(), "server");
let key = "";
try {
    let cookieValue =
        String(cookie.getCookie(base_url)) || String(java.getCookie(base_url));
    key = getKey(cookieValue);
} catch (e) {
    key = "";
}

if (key == "") {
    java.log("当前服务器未查询到登录状态，尝试查询其他服务器登录状态...");
    let cookieValue;
    for (let h of host) {
        try {
            cookieValue = String(cookie.getCookie(h)) || String(java.getCookie(h));
            key = getKey(cookieValue);
        } catch (e) {
            key = "";
        }
        if (key) {
            java.log(`已在${h}登录，退出查询，正在转移登录状态到当前服务${base_url}`);
            //java.log(cookieValue)
            cookie.removeCookie(h);
            cookie.removeCookie(base_url);
            cookie.setCookie(base_url, cookieValue);
            break;
        }
    }
}

if (book.readConfig == null || book.readConfig.useReplaceRule == null) {
    book.setUseReplaceRule(false);
}

let nickname = '账号状态：⚠️ 未登录 | 点击右上角 🔖 登录';
try {
    let opcx = {
        method: "GET",
        headers: {
            cookie: 'qttoken=' + key + ';'
        },
    };
    opcx = JSON.stringify(opcx);
    let user_info = JSON.parse(java.ajax(base_url + '/get_avatar,' + opcx));
    if (user_info.code == 0) {
        if (user_info.nickname) {
            nickname = '欢迎回来：' + user_info.nickname
        } else {
            nickname = '欢迎回来：' + user_info.email + "(请前往用户后台设置用户名)"
        }
    }
} catch (e) {
    if (key) {
        nickname = '账号状态：已登录'
    }
};

let loginStatus = nickname;

let lightDivider = "❇️───────❇️───────❇️";
let heavyDivider = "‎\n‎";

let isValid = (value) => String(value).length > 1;

let info = `
    📡 当前服务：${base_url}
    🔑 ${loginStatus}
    🏷 数据来源：${sources}
    🔄 当前模式：${tab}
    ⚙️ 访问模式：${proxy}
`;

if (tab == "听书") {
    let toneId = getArguments(source.getVariable(), "tone_id");
    if (isValid(book_tts)) {
        info += `${lightDivider}
    🎵 音色配置：${toneId}
    ${book_tts}
`;
    }
}

let basicInfo = "";
let addBasicInfo = (value, prefix, icon) => {
    if (isValid(value)) basicInfo += `    ${icon} ${prefix} ${value}\n`;
};

addBasicInfo(tags, "书籍分类：", "🌈");
addBasicInfo(role, "书籍主角：", "👑");
addBasicInfo(last_chapter_title, "最新章节：", "📚");
addBasicInfo(last_chapter_update_time, "更新时间：", "⏳");
addBasicInfo(word_number, "书籍字数：", "📊");
addBasicInfo(status, "书籍状态：", "🚩");
addBasicInfo(score, "书籍评分：", "⭐");

if (basicInfo) info += `${lightDivider}\n${basicInfo}`;

if (isValid(abstract)) {
    let indentedAbstract = abstract
        .split("\n")
        .map((line) => `    ${line}`)
        .join("\n");
    info += `${heavyDivider}
    📖 书籍简介：
${indentedAbstract}
`;
} else {
    info += `${heavyDivider}`;
}

if (isValid(copyright_info)) {
    info += `${lightDivider}
    © ${copyright_info}
`;
} else {
    info += `${lightDivider}`;
}

info += `
${heavyDivider}
    💠💠💠 数据更新于 ${new Date().toLocaleString()} 💠💠💠
`;
let jjinfo = getArguments(source.getVariable(), "info");

if (jjinfo != "on") {
    info = String(info)
        .split("\n")
        .map((line) => line.replace(/^ {4}/, ""))
        .join("\n");
} else {
    basicInfo = "";
    addBasicInfo(last_chapter_title, "最新章节：", "📚");
    addBasicInfo(last_chapter_update_time, "更新时间：", "⏳");
    addBasicInfo(word_number, "书籍字数：", "📊");
    addBasicInfo(status, "书籍状态：", "🚩");
    addBasicInfo(score, "书籍评分：", "⭐");
    if (isValid(abstract)) {
        let indentedAbstract = abstract
            .split("\n")
            .map((line) => `    ${line}`)
            .join("\n");
        basicInfo += `
    \n‎
    📖 书籍简介：
${indentedAbstract}
`;
    } else {
        basicInfo += `${heavyDivider}`;
    }
    info = `‎\n🏷 数据来源：${sources}\n` + basicInfo;
}

<js>
var JsDom = Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup;
var Document = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Document;
var Element = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Element;
            
var document = JsDom.parse(src);
            
// 获取包含<li>元素的<div>元素
var divs = document.select('ul.list > div');

// 将divs转换为数组以便排序
var divArray = [];
for (var i = 0; i < divs.size(); i++) {
    divArray.push(divs.get(i));
}

// 按照data-id属性对divArray进行排序
divArray.sort(function(a, b) {
    var pageA = parseInt(a.attr('data-id'), 10);
    var pageB = parseInt(b.attr('data-id'), 10);
    return pageA - pageB;
});

var list = [];
// 遍历排序后的divArray
for (var i = 0; i < divArray.length; i++) {
    var div = divArray[i];
    var dataId = div.attr('data-id');
    // 获取当前div下的所有<li>元素
    var lis = div.select('li');
    for (var j = 0; j < lis.size(); j++) {
        var li = lis.get(j);
        var a = li.select('a').first();
        if (a != null) {
            list.push({
                text: a.text(),
                id: dataId, // 使用data-id属性
                url: a.attr('href')
            });
        }
    }
}

//java.log(JSON.stringify(list));
list;
</js>

var divs = document.select('ul.list > div');

// 将divs转换为数组以便排序
var divArray = [];
for (var i = 0; i < divs.size(); i++) {
    divArray.push(divs.get(i));
}

// 按照data-id属性对divArray进行排序
divArray.sort(function(a, b) {
    var pageA = parseInt(a.attr('data-id'), 10);
    var pageB = parseInt(b.attr('data-id'), 10);
    return pageA - pageB;
});

var list = [];
// 遍历排序后的divArray
for (var i = 0; i < divArray.length; i++) {
    var div = divArray[i];
    var dataId = div.attr('data-id');
    // 获取当前div下的所有<li>元素
    var lis = div.select('li');
    for (var j = 0; j < lis.size(); j++) {
        var li = lis.get(j);
        var a = li.select('a').first();
        if (a != null) {
            list.push({
                text: a.text(),
                id: dataId, // 使用data-id属性
                url: a.attr('href')
            });
        }
    }
}

//java.log(JSON.stringify(list));
list;
</js>

title=String(title).replace(/^\s+/,'');
intro=$.chapterintro;
vip=$.isvip!='0';
lock=$.islock!='0';
type=$.chaptertype=='1'?true:false;
num=!type?$.chapterid+"  ☪ ":'';

//下面被注释的代码是已经有章节数的前面就不加序号了
bbb = book.getVariable("custom");
sss = source.getVariable();
if(/去章节序号/.test(bbb) || /去章节序号/.test(sss)){
num=''
}else{num=num}

title=type?'📖 '+title+' 📖':title;
if( (/目录简介/.test(bbb) || /目录简介/.test(sss))&&!/📖/.test(title)){
	title = title + " ❖ "+intro
	}else{
		title = title
		java.put("intro1",intro);
		}
v=vip&&!type?' ◇':'';
l=lock?'[此章节已锁]':'';
result=num+title+l+v;
</js>

variableComment:
1、书籍变量（当前书）
填写 [去章节序号] —— 去除章节序号
填写 [目录简介] —— 章节简介放到目录列表，正文不出现
填写 [评论+评论数量]——如 评论50  则可以显示50条评论，数量必填

2、源变量（所有书）
其余同书籍变量
填写[搜索+书名] —— 必须在第一行，搜索百合书籍，在发现里点击[百合搜索]

更改过后都要重新刷新

jsLib:
time = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000).toString()

function getSign (key, type, num) {
  const { java } = this
  const secret = 'magic2019'
  let baseString

  switch (type) {
    case 's':
      baseString = `channel=ft0001&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=0&query=${java.encodeURI(key)}&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 't':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&gid=1&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 'c':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&chapterid=${num}&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    default:
      throw new Error('Invalid type')
  }

  return java.md5Encode(baseString).toUpperCase()
}

      url: url,
      info: `更新时间: ${chapter.uT} 字数: ${chapter.cnt}`,
      voltype: false
    })
  })
})

function qmVideoUploadIds(kind, page) {

    qmResetVideoState.call(this, kind)

  }
  var state = qmVideoState.call(this, kind)
  var ids = []
  Object.keys(state.pages || {}).sort(function (a, b) { return Number(a) - Number(b) }).forEach(function (key) {
    if (Number(key) < Number(page)) ids = ids.concat(state.pages[key] || [])
  })
  var seen = {}
  return ids.filter(function (id) { id = String(id); if (!id || seen[id]) return false; seen[id] = 1; return true }).slice(-120).map(function (id) {
    return {id:String(id),item_type:kind == 'animated' ? '14' : '11',ts:String(Date.now()),type:'0'}
  })

function qmRememberVideoPage(kind, page, items) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  if (!runtimeCache) return items
  page = String(Number(page || 1) || 1)
  var state = qmVideoState.call(this, kind)
  var prior = {}
  Object.keys(state.pages || {}).forEach(function (key) {
    if (key != page) (state.pages[key] || []).forEach(function (id) { prior[String(id)] = 1 })
  })
  var current = []
  var local = {}
  var filtered = items.filter(function (item) {
    var id = qmItemId(item, 'video')
    if (!id || local[id] || prior[id]) return false
    local[id] = 1
    current.push(String(id))
    return true
  })
  state.pages[page] = current
  Object.keys(state.pages).forEach(function (key) { if (Number(key) < Number(page) - 8) delete state.pages[key] })
  runtimeCache.putMemory('qm-video-pages-' + kind, JSON.stringify(state))
  return filtered
}

  return date.getFullYear() + '-' + two(date.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + two(date.getDate()) + ' ' + two(date.getHours()) + ':' + two(date.getMinutes())
}

  function findExtra(pattern) {
    for (var i = 0; i < extras.length; i++) {
      if (pattern.test(String(extras[i].sub_title || extras[i].title || ''))) return qmExtraInfoText(extras[i])
    }
    return ''
  }
  var score = attribute.score || findExtra(/评分|评价/)
  if (score && String(score).indexOf('分') < 0) score = String(score) + '分'
  var reading = ''
  var readingList = attribute.reading_info_list || []
  if (readingList.length > 2) reading = qmExtraInfoText(readingList[2]) || String(readingList[2].title || readingList[2].text || '')
  if (!reading) reading = findExtra(/正在阅读|在线/)

  if (raw.isbn) lines.push('🔖 ISBN：' + raw.isbn)

function qmCommentPageData(input) {
  try {
    input = input || {}
    var ctx = this
    var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(ctx)
    var kind = String(input.kind || 'paragraph')
    var cursor = String(input.cursor || '')
    var response
    var data
    var list = []
    var tags = []
    var total = ''
    var next = ''
    if (kind == 'book') {
      var bookId = String(input.bookId || '')
      var bookHot = String(input.hot || '0') == '1'
      var bp = {circle_id:bookId,need_common:'0',tag_id:String(input.tag || '1'),book_id:bookId,sort:bookHot ? '0' : '1'}
      if (cursor) bp.next_id = cursor
      response = qmGet.call(ctx, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/community/book-evaluates', bp)
      data = response.data || {}
      list = (data.list || []).map(function (x) { return qmCommentItem.call(ctx, x, bookHot, false) })
      var evaluateInfo = data.evaluates_info || {}
      if (!cursor) total = String(evaluateInfo.eval_comment_count || data.comment_count || list.length)
      next = String(data.next_id || '')
      tags = (evaluateInfo.tag_list || data.tag_list || []).map(function (x) { return {id:String(x.id || x.tag_id || '1'),title:String(x.title || x.name || '全部'),count:String(x.count || x.comment_count || '')} })
    } else {
      var hot = String(input.hot || '0') == '1' ? '1' : '0'
      var params = {book_id:String(input.bookId || ''),chapter_id:String(input.chapterId || '')}
      if (kind == 'paragraph') params.paragraph_id = String(input.paragraphId || '')
      params.hot = hot
      if (kind == 'paragraph') params.check_cmt_id = String(input.checkId || '')
      var firstUrl = kind == 'paragraph' ? 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/paragraph/first' : 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/chapter-comment/first'
      var moreUrl = kind == 'paragraph' ? 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/paragraph/more' : 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/chapter-comment/more'
      if (cursor) {
        params.next_id = cursor
        response = qmGet.call(ctx, moreUrl, params)
      } else {
        params.exposed_ids = ''
        params.need_common = hot == '1' ? '1' : '0'
        if (kind == 'chapter') params.extra = ''
        response = qmPostForm.call(ctx, firstUrl, params)
      }
      data = response.data || {}
      if (cursor) {
        list = (data.comment_list || []).map(function (x) { return qmCommentItem.call(ctx, x, false) })
        next = String(data.next_id || '')
      } else {
        var hotZone = data.hot_zone || {}

        var hotList = hotZone.comment_list || []

function qmSvg(kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot) {

  count = Math.min(count, 999)

    var displayText = String(Math.min(count, 999))
    var custom = cfg.template == '起点' ? '' : qmLoginValue.call(this, cfg.template.replace('样式', '◎ 气泡'), '')
    svg = custom.trim() ? custom.replace(/\$\{qpyscolor\}/g, color).replace(/\$\{qpwzcolor\}/g, color).replace(/\$\{font\}/g, 'Arial').replace(/\$\{displayText\}/g, displayText) :

  } else if (normalizedKind == 'book' || normalizedKind == 'chapter') {

  } else {

  }

function qmNovelContent(text, baseUrl) {
  var ctx = this
  var raw = qmParse(text).data || {}
  var bid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'id')
  var cid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'chapterId')
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(ctx)
  var readerType = qmReaderType(ctx, baseUrl)
  var content = readerType == '3' ? qmEpubRemoteDecrypt.call(ctx, raw.content || '') : qmDecryptChapter(raw.content || '')
  if (!qmCommentsAllowed(ctx, baseUrl)) return content
  var marks = {}
  if (cfg.paragraph || cfg.god) {
    try {
      var bubbleResponse = qmPostForm.call(ctx, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v1/paragraph/bubbles', {
        book_id:bid,chapters:JSON.stringify([{chapter_id:cid,chapter_md5:String(raw.content_md5 || '')}])
      })
      var chapters = bubbleResponse.data && bubbleResponse.data.chapters || []
      var bubbles = chapters.length ? chapters[0].bubbles || [] : []
      bubbles.forEach(function (item) {
        var count = Number(item.c || 0)
        if (count > 0 || item.gid || item.gtxt) marks[String(item.p)] = {count:count,hot:String(item.hot || '') == '1',gid:String(item.gid || ''),gtxt:String(item.gtxt || '')}
      })
    } catch (bubbleError) {}
  }
  var lines = String(content).split('\n')
  lines.forEach(function (line, index) {
    var pid = qmMd5(line).slice(0, 8)
    var mark = marks[pid]
    if (!mark || !line) return
    var bubble = cfg.paragraph ? qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'paragraph', bid, cid, pid, mark.count, mark.hot ? '热门段评' : '七猫段评', mark.gid, mark.hot) : ''
    if (bubble) lines[index] += bubble
    var god = cfg.god ? qmGodImage.call(ctx, bid, cid, pid, mark.gid, mark.gtxt) : ''
    if (god) lines[index] += '\n' + god
  })
  if (cfg.chapter) try { var chapterBubble = qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'chapter', bid, cid, '', qmChapterReviewCount.call(ctx, bid, cid), '本章说'); if (chapterBubble) lines.push(chapterBubble) } catch (chapterError) {}
  if (cfg.book) try { var bookBubble = qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'book', bid, '', '', qmBookReviewCount.call(ctx, bid), '本书书评'); if (bookBubble) lines.push(bookBubble) } catch (bookError) {}
  return lines.join('\n')
}

function qmReadContent(text, baseUrl) {
  if (/^data:;base64,/.test(String(baseUrl)) && /["']type["']\s*:\s*["']video["']/.test(String(baseUrl))) {
    return qmHexDecodeAscii(text)
  }
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/playlet/api/info') >= 0) {
    var video = qmParse(text).data || {}
    var playList = video.play_list || []
    var sort = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'qm_sort')
    var runtimeChapter = qmChapterOf(this)
    if (!sort) {
      try {
        var titleMatch = String(runtimeChapter && runtimeChapter.title || '').match(/第\s*(\d+)\s*集/)
        if (titleMatch) sort = titleMatch[1]
      } catch (titleError) {}
    }
    var item = playList.filter(function (x) { return sort && String(x.sort) == String(sort) })[0]
    if (!item) {
      var chapterIndex = -1
      try { chapterIndex = Number(runtimeChapter && runtimeChapter.index) } catch (indexError) {}
      if (chapterIndex >= 0) item = playList[chapterIndex]
    }
    if (!item) item = playList.filter(function (x) { return !!(x.video_url || x.video_url_h265) })[0] || {}
    return String(item.video_url || item.video_url_h265 || '')
  }
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/album/info') >= 0) {
    var audio = qmParse(text).data || {}
    var voices = audio.voice_list || []
    return voices.length ? String(voices[0].voice_url) : '本集暂无可播放音频'
  }
  return qmNovelContent.call(this, text, baseUrl)
}

"); } else if(baseUrl.match(/\/\d+\.html/)){ result = java.getElements("#articlecontent@p"); } else { // 加载外部JS文件 cryptojs_min.js eval(String(java.ajax("http://danmeirouwen.net/17mb/js/jquery-1.9.1.min.js"))); // 定义函数d(a, b)用于解密操作 function d(a, b) { // 将b进行MD5加密并转换为字符串 b = CryptoJS.MD5(b).toString(); // 提取加密后字符串的前16位和后面部分作为iv和参数创建对象 var d = CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse(b.substring(0, 16)); var e = CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse(b.substring(16)); // 使用AES解密算法对a进行解密，并将结果转换为字符串格式 return CryptoJS.AES.decrypt(a, e, { iv: d, padding: CryptoJS.pad.Pkcs7 }).toString(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8); } // 使用正则表达式匹配出来的信息作为参数调用函数d，并将结果赋值给result变量 result = eval(result.match(/(d\("[\s\S]+"\))\)/)[1]); } }

<js>
jm=java.base64Decode(java.getString('[name="client"]@content'));
if(jm.length()>1){
var conts = [],list=[];
code=result.match(/codeurl="(\d+)";/)[1];
data=org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
datas=data.select("p[style*='text-indent']");
jm=String(jm).split(/[A-Z]+%/);
for(i=0;i<jm.length;i++){
	k=Math.ceil((i + 1) % parseInt(code));
	j=Math.ceil(jm[i] - k);
	conts[j]=datas[i];
	}
	for(i in conts){
		c=String(conts[i]).replace(/.*本章尚未读完,请.*一页继续阅读.*/g,'');
		list.push(c);
		list.join("\n");
		}
	}else{java.getString(".novelcontent@html")}
</js>

<js>
var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
     Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.java.util 
);
with(javaImport){
    let IV_PARAMETER = String("1ae2c94b");
    let ALGORITHM = "DES"; 
    let CIPHER_ALGORITHM = "DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding";
    let CHARSET = "utf-8";
    let password=String("KK!%G3JdCHJxpAF3%Vg9pN");


function decode(data){
let dks = new DESKeySpec(String(password).getBytes());
let keyFactory = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("DES");
let secretKey = keyFactory.generateSecret(dks);
let cipher = Cipher.getInstance(CIPHER_ALGORITHM);
let iv = new IvParameterSpec(IV_PARAMETER.getBytes(CHARSET));
cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, iv);
return new String(cipher.doFinal(Base64.getDecoder().decode(String(data).getBytes(CHARSET))), CHARSET);

}
}
//DES解密结束

content=java.getElement("$.content");
saybody=java.getString("$.sayBody");
say=saybody!=""?"\n作者有话要说：\n"+saybody:"";

result=String(decode(content)+say);

};
